about: Rows layered over the cosmos port by pricing/port-from-cosmos.ts, where a vendor's published list prices differ from, or are missing in, cosmos src/shared/model-pricing.ts: OpenAI's (Standard tier, GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini included, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol with their Fast rows, and GPT-6.2 Astra for Law), Google's Gemini API pages (Standard paid tier, text / image / video) and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's (Singapore, International deployment) for the Gemini CLI, Antigravity and Qwen Code models (Google's: Gemini 2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Flash-Lite, 3 Flash Preview, 3.5 / 3.7 Flash, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Neon); and, for models the other harnesses' sessions name, Anthropic's (the Claude API table: Claude Sonnet 4's spellings and Warp's family-last Claude ids), Cognition's Devin model page (the SWE-2 and SWE-2 Flash list prices), Z.ai's (GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash and GLM-5.3-FlashX), the Kimi API platform's (Kimi K3 and Kimi K3.1 Pro), MiniMax's (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3, Standard tier), OpenCode Console's (Big Pickle and the Console's `-free` models, which its table lists Free: $0 on every class while it does), xAI's (Grok 4, whose retired id bills at Grok 4.3's rates), Inception's (Mercury 3), Agnes AI's (Agnes 3.0 Flash and 2.5 Flash, list price), GitHub Copilot's models-and-pricing page (MAI-Code-1.1-Flash and MAI-Code-2-Flash, which Microsoft bills at that list price), Z.ai's (also GLM-5.2, GLM-4.5 and the free GLM-4.7-Flash / GLM-4.5-Flash), the Kimi API platform's (also Kimi K2.7 Code), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's (also Qwen3.8-27B), Upstage's (Solar Pro 4), Mistral's (Mistral Large 4) and OpenRouter's (its `:free` variants, each listed at zero: $0 on every class; and the models API's `pricing` object for open-weight models whose maker publishes no per-token price: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra and 3.5 Super VL, gpt-oss-120b / 20b, Gemma 4 31B IT, Beam 1.0 501B, MiniMax-M2.7, DeepSeek-V3.1, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, Qwen3-Coder, and Tencent's Hy4 / Hy4 flash, whose maker prices them in CNY only). A maker's own per-token page wins; OpenRouter's catalog is cited only where none exists, at its catalog price, not its page header's cheapest endpoint. No rate is converted from another currency: a model priced only in CNY stays null. A Google model with implicit caching only has no write price and writes at its input rate; a Qwen model on Model Studio's explicit cache writes at 125% of input and reads at 10%. `intro` is the source's dated price: its rates through `until`, the row's own from the next day, which a cited line names. `change` is a dated rate change (cosmos d74141126e's): from `from` (a UTC day, inclusive, which a cited line names) the whole row bills as `change.pricing`, its own intro included. Rates are USD per 1M tokens in the source's shape: cacheWrite is the 30-minute cache write (billed on the cache_write_5m class), cacheWrite1h the 12-hour write (cache_write_1h). A model the pages list with no write price (every model before GPT-5.6: "No additional cache-write charge") writes at its input rate; one with no cached-input price ("-") reads at its input rate. longContext reprices the WHOLE request past overTokens prompt tokens (strict: over). `replace` reprices the source row whose pattern is `match` and refuses once that row no longer prices at `was`; its `anchor`, when set, is the pattern the row carries instead, releasing the ids the source's took and it does not to price null or on a row of this layer; `insert` adds a row ahead of the row whose pattern is `before`, or after every row when `before` is null. `fast` adds the Fast-mode row of the Standard row whose pattern is `of`, right ahead of it, matching only that model's `-fast` ids and priced at exactly `multiplier` x it (the Fast table: 2x, except gpt-5.5 2.5x and gpt-5-mini 1.8x); a model the Fast table does not list has no Fast row and its `-fast` ids price null. `promotion` marks a promotional price the page gives no end date for. `pages` records each page as read (sha256 of the body); quotes are verbatim lines of it, table padding collapsed, or, where a page carries its whole table on one script line (Devin's and Kimi's render client-side), a verbatim excerpt of that line. An Anthropic row carries the table's own two write prices (5-minute and 1-hour); a model whose page lists one write price bills both classes at it. `aliases` names ids no page prices that bill on an existing row at its rates (its pattern becomes `<of>|<match>`): no rates and no cites, only who decided it and when.

rows.why: The 12-hour cache write is 2.5x input (cosmos carries the 30-minute 1.25x in cacheWrite1h too); every other rate already matches the page. Anchored to the model's own spellings (an effort word, a dated snapshot, a [...] tag), so ids the page prices apart or not at all (`gpt-6.1-sol-ultrafast`, a Law configuration, a `:batch` id) are not billed at its Standard rate.
